description:
Brand introduction:

Life is Pain is a party game featuring irreverant humor, strategic gameplay (deduction & deception), and hysterical punishments. Our brand strives to juxtapose the mundane frustations of everyday life with the humor that lies within them. Our product is not suitable for children and most teenagers so if your audience is mainly below the age of 16 or parents, then we won't be a great fit. Outside of that we are open to influencers that specialize in all sorts of content (including NSFW) but we prioritize comedic content. 

Brand Comparison: Cards Against Humanity

Product description:

Life is Pain is the base game and currently our only product but with expansions coming soon. The card game features ten categories ranging from Public Embarassment, Awkward Sexual Experiences, to Poor Financial Decisions. Each category has four cards, each of which depicts a unique and hilarious example of the category it is in. There are two "F*** You" cards (profane language depicted in game). Each game all of the category cards and 1-2 F*** You cards, depending on the number of participants, are shuffled and dealt to all players. The goal is to find matching pairs of your categories and not get stuck with a F*** You card. The person(s) that end the game with the F*** You card is the loser and must take a punishment. The gameplay can be described as if Cards Against Humanity, Go Fish, and Old Maid got together and had a sadistic baby.

How to Play Video

Contents include:

  • 40 Category Cards
  • 2 F*** You Cards
  • 69 Punishment cards (Nice...)
  • Rulebook + Quickstart Guide
  • 8 How to Play Cards + 1 How to Punish Card

USP (Unique Selling Point):

  • Can be learned in 2 minutes
  • Instead of winning, the goal is NOT to lose
  • Losers take punishments
  • Gameplay is casual and fast paced
